```{r load-data}
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)
library(car)

data("vacation")

head(vacation)
str(vacation)
```

## (a) OLS 估計與 KIDS 的 95% 信賴區間

```{r part-a}
ols_model <- lm(miles ~ income + age + kids, data = vacation)
summary(ols_model)

confint(ols_model, "kids", level = 0.95)

cat("\n--- 解讀 ---\n")
cat(sprintf("KIDS 的係數估計值: %.4f\n", coef(ols_model)["kids"]))
cat(sprintf("95%% 信賴區間: [%.4f, %.4f]\n",
            confint(ols_model, "kids")[1], confint(ols_model, "kids")[2]))
cat("在其他變數不變的情況下，每多一個小孩對里程數的影響。\n")
```

## (b) 殘差圖：檢查異質變異

```{r part-b, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
resid_ols <- residuals(ols_model)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

plot(vacation$income, resid_ols,
     xlab = "INCOME", ylab = "OLS Residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs INCOME",
     pch = 16, col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.5))
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
lines(lowess(vacation$income, resid_ols), col = "red", lwd = 2)

plot(vacation$age, resid_ols,
     xlab = "AGE", ylab = "OLS Residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs AGE",
     pch = 16, col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.5))
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
lines(lowess(vacation$age, resid_ols), col = "red", lwd = 2)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

```

## (c) Goldfeld–Quandt 檢定

```{r part-c}
vacation_sorted <- vacation[order(vacation$income), ]

n <- nrow(vacation_sorted)
n1 <- 90
n2 <- 90
d  <- n - n1 - n2

model_low <- lm(miles ~ income + age + kids,
                data = vacation_sorted[1:n1, ])
model_high <- lm(miles ~ income + age + kids,
                 data = vacation_sorted[(n - n2 + 1):n, ])

summary(model_low)
summary(model_high)

SSE1 <- sum(residuals(model_low)^2)
SSE2 <- sum(residuals(model_high)^2)
k <- length(coef(ols_model))

df1 <- n1 - k
df2 <- n2 - k

cat(sprintf("SSE (低所得組): %.4f, df = %d\n", SSE1, df1))
cat(sprintf("SSE (高所得組): %.4f, df = %d\n", SSE2, df2))

GQ <- (SSE2 / df2) / (SSE1 / df1)
cat(sprintf("\nGQ 統計量 = %.4f\n", GQ))

F_crit <- qf(0.95, df2, df1)
cat(sprintf("F 臨界值 (alpha=0.05, df1=%d, df2=%d) = %.4f\n", df2, df1, F_crit))

p_value <- 1 - pf(GQ, df2, df1)
cat(sprintf("p-value = %.6f\n", p_value))

if (GQ > F_crit) {
  cat("結論：拒絕 H0，有顯著證據顯示存在異質變異。\n")
} else {
  cat("結論：無法拒絕 H0，沒有足夠證據顯示存在異質變異。\n")
}

```

## (d) OLS + 異質變異穩健標準誤 (HC) 與 95% 信賴區間

```{r part-d}
robust_se <- coeftest(ols_model, vcov = vcovHC(ols_model, type = "HC1"))
robust_se

se_kids_robust <- sqrt(vcovHC(ols_model, type = "HC1")["kids", "kids"])
b_kids <- coef(ols_model)["kids"]
t_crit <- qt(0.975, df = ols_model$df.residual)

ci_robust <- b_kids + c(-1, 1) * t_crit * se_kids_robust

cat(sprintf("\nKIDS 係數: %.4f\n", b_kids))
cat(sprintf("穩健標準誤: %.4f\n", se_kids_robust))
cat(sprintf("95%% 穩健信賴區間: [%.4f, %.4f]\n", ci_robust[1], ci_robust[2]))

ci_ols <- confint(ols_model, "kids")
cat(sprintf("\n(a) OLS 信賴區間:    [%.4f, %.4f], 寬度 = %.4f\n",
            ci_ols[1], ci_ols[2], ci_ols[2] - ci_ols[1]))
cat(sprintf("(d) 穩健信賴區間:    [%.4f, %.4f], 寬度 = %.4f\n",
            ci_robust[1], ci_robust[2], ci_robust[2] - ci_robust[1]))
```

## (e) GLS 估計（假設 $\sigma_i^2 = \sigma^2 \cdot INCOME_i^2$）

```{r part-e}
vacation_gls <- vacation[vacation$income > 0, ]

gls_model <- lm(miles ~ income + age + kids,
                data = vacation_gls,
                weights = 1 / (income^2))
summary(gls_model)

ci_gls_conv <- confint(gls_model, "kids", level = 0.95)
cat("=== 傳統 GLS 標準誤 ===\n")
cat(sprintf("KIDS 係數: %.4f\n", coef(gls_model)["kids"]))
cat(sprintf("95%% 信賴區間: [%.4f, %.4f]\n", ci_gls_conv[1], ci_gls_conv[2]))

robust_gls <- coeftest(gls_model, vcov = vcovHC(gls_model, type = "HC1"))
robust_gls

se_kids_gls_robust <- sqrt(vcovHC(gls_model, type = "HC1")["kids", "kids"])
b_kids_gls <- coef(gls_model)["kids"]
t_crit_gls <- qt(0.975, df = gls_model$df.residual)

ci_gls_robust <- b_kids_gls + c(-1, 1) * t_crit_gls * se_kids_gls_robust

cat("\n=== 穩健 GLS 標準誤 ===\n")
cat(sprintf("穩健標準誤: %.4f\n", se_kids_gls_robust))
cat(sprintf("95%% 信賴區間: [%.4f, %.4f]\n", ci_gls_robust[1], ci_gls_robust[2]))

cat("\n========== 信賴區間比較 ==========\n")
cat(sprintf("(a) OLS 一般標準誤:     [%.4f, %.4f], 寬度 = %.4f\n",
            ci_ols[1], ci_ols[2], ci_ols[2] - ci_ols[1]))
cat(sprintf("(d) OLS 穩健標準誤:     [%.4f, %.4f], 寬度 = %.4f\n",
            ci_robust[1], ci_robust[2], ci_robust[2] - ci_robust[1]))
cat(sprintf("(e) GLS 傳統標準誤:     [%.4f, %.4f], 寬度 = %.4f\n",
            ci_gls_conv[1], ci_gls_conv[2], ci_gls_conv[2] - ci_gls_conv[1]))
cat(sprintf("(e) GLS 穩健標準誤:     [%.4f, %.4f], 寬度 = %.4f\n",
            ci_gls_robust[1], ci_gls_robust[2], ci_gls_robust[2] - ci_gls_robust[1]))
cat("\n若異質變異假設正確，GLS 估計量較有效率，信賴區間應較窄。\n")
```
